#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -eu
cd /mnt/c/Users/h_kis/Desktop/B-Free-master/Program/bfree_x86_64
echo "=== OBJ symbols (latest compile ~00:22) ==="
nm kernel/sysmain/syscall.o | grep -E 'as_copy|inet_|parked|exec_transfer|unix_socks|coop_as' | head -25
echo "=== SRC (git HEAD restore) marker counts ==="
for s in g_guest_fork_was_as_copy bfree_inet_from_fd g_bfree_exec_transfer_rip g_unix_socks g_inet_socks; do
  printf "%5d  %s\n" "$(grep -c -- "$s" kernel/sysmain/syscall.c || true)" "$s"
done
echo "=== sizes ==="
wc -c kernel/sysmain/syscall.c kernel/sysmain/syscall.o
if [ -f iso_root/boot/kernel.elf ]; then
  echo "=== iso kernel.elf ==="
  ls -la iso_root/boot/kernel.elf
  nm iso_root/boot/kernel.elf | grep -E 'as_copy|inet_|parked|exec_transfer' | head -10 || true
fi
